tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub brnyes sangs rgyas gsang ba yi/ /thugs dam lung lugs tshe sgrub kyi/ /nyams len snying gi thig le 'di'i/ /'gro kun 'jigs med tshe bcud bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pad+ma ā yur+dz+nyā nā ya/ 'dir grub pa'i slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gsang ba'i bka' srol mgon po tshe dpag med lung lugs gtso bo yab yum gyi rgyun khyer mdor bsdus don tshang ni/ 'di'i tshe dbang thob pa'i gang zag gis stan bde bar bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug la/ na mo rtsa gsum mchog gsum kun 'dus lha/ /tshe dpag med mgon snyigs 'gro'i skyabs/ /thugs rje'i bdag la rang gzhan kun/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /nyer gcig nas gsum bar/ bdag dang sems can 'khor mtsho las/ /bsgral phyir 'chi med tshe yi lha/ /yab yum bskyed rdzogs nyams su blang / /kun kyang 'chi med mchog thob shog /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswā bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri la pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du rang rig āḥdamar po 'bar ba/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bsal/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ a ro l̥ka rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i ngang tshul can/ phyag g.yon mnyam bzhag gi 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang / g.yas pas rdo rje rgya gram bum pa'i kha bkab pa'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs ka nas g.yon gyi brla'i steng du paṃ dmar po mched/ pāṃ rā ga ra ti/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas mda' dar le brgan g.yab cing g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa gnyis ka'ang mtshan dpe'i lang tsho 'bar zhing dar gyi chas gos lnga dang /

rin po che'i rgyan brgyad de zhi ba'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyis spras pa'o/ /de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bcing ste mnyes par byas/ oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga a ha ra dhū pe/ puṣ+pe/ ā lo ke/ ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe yab yum/ /rnam dag sku gsung thugs kyi gter/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /srid zhi'i skyabs gcig khyod la bstod/ /bzlas pa ni/ snying ga'i sa bon bzla bya'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod/ thugs rje'i nus mthu dang / sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang ye shes bsod nams/ 'byung ba bzhi'i mdangs bcud thams cad bsdus te snying kha'i sngags phreng la thim/ oṃ puṇ+yai puṇ+yai ma hā puṇ+yai a pa ri mi tā ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba ro pa tsit+ta swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas la bdag gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ spros pa yum gyi mkha' nang du rdo rje rgya gram steng 'og gnyis su gyur pa'i bar du nyi zla kha sbyor gyi lte bar tshe'i rang bzhin thig le dkar po nṛs mtshan par gyur/ badz+ra mug ti ha/ rang gi thugs ka nas pho nya nam mkha' gang bar spros/ 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi tshe bcud thams cad bsdus te mkha' nang gi tshe rten la thim/ oṃ puṇ+ye sogs gong gi tshe gzungs tshar gcig ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe yi mchog /snod bcud tshe nyams nṛ la bsdu/ /'bru lnga dang ni snying po lnga/ /gnas lnga dag tu byin brlabs na/ /rnal 'byor tshe la bar chad med/ /oṃ puṇ+ye sogs gong bzhin tshar gcig oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ steng 'og gi rgya gram gnyis kyi rtse mo ā li kā li'i skud pas bcings te cis kyang mi shigs par gyur pas de nyid rang gi snying gar drangs te gnas par gyur/

tshe sba ba ni/ rang yab yum du gsal ba stod smad nas 'od dmar po zhu/ snying ga'i rdo rje rgya gram kha sbyor ā li kā lis bcings pa la thim/ de nyi zla kha sbyor 'od dkar po nṛ dang bcas pa la thim/ nṛ yang stong pa'i ngang du thim par gyur/ mi 'gyur cis kyang mi shigs pa/ /stong pa'i go cha bla na med/ /mtshan ma'i spyod yul kun bcom nas/ /thams cad kun las rgyal bar gnas/ /ma byung mi gnas 'dus ma byas/ /chos kyi dbyings su tshe sbas pas/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs mi 'gyur/ /badz+ra kā wa tsi rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod la cung zad mnyam par bzhag rang skad cig gis tshe dpag med yab yum du gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /hūm̐/ thabs shes rang bzhin don gyi tshe/ /dbyings las shar ba rgyal ba'i sku/ /'chi med mdzod cig yab yum gyis/ /'gyur med tshe yi bkra shis shog /ces 'di sa skya pa kun blos/ /glo bo a haṃ bang gi rgyal/ /rdo rje'i mtshan la 'di phul skabs/ /rang gzhan nyams myong shar ba zhig /byung bzhin bla slob rgyun 'don du/ /skal ldan rgyal po des bskul bzhin/ /mgyogs par bris so gsang chen snying / /rig 'dzin rnams kyis bzod byin rlobs// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ sangs rgyas gsang ba thugs dam tshe sgrub kyi nyams len/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
